plant.compliance: Vitis is a known host genus of Xylella fastidiosa. A plant passport is required for trade movement.
plant.foliage: deciduous; very large rounded heart-shaped leaves with felted undersides and vivid autumn colour
plant.hardinessNote: Hardy in all of the UK, including very cold winters, approximately -20 to -15°C.
plant.pollination: not applicable; grown for foliage, not fruit
plant.prune: Prune in midwinter while fully dormant, as cuts bleed sap in spring. Cut back side shoots and remove excess growth to keep it in bounds.
plant.resilience: Very hardy and vigorous once established and copes with most soils. Autumn colour is best in sun. Pests: generally few; powdery mildew and vine weevil are possible.
plant.soilWarning: Very vigorous; needs strong support and room
